name: m365-mcp
description: Local MCP server for one Microsoft 365 user: mail, folders, rules, categories, contacts, calendar, SharePoint browsing, and in-place Excel editing.
long_description:
Gives an MCP client delegated Microsoft Graph access to a single user's Microsoft 365 account.

- Read, search, draft, move, flag, and categorize mail, including shared/delegated mailboxes. Sending is off unless enabled.
- Create, rename, and delete mail folders; manage Outlook Inbox rules and master categories.
- Read message threads and small text/PDF attachments.
- View image attachments and inline pictures embedded in message bodies.
- Look at PDF attachments page by page, including scanned documents, by rendering pages to images.
- Search, create, update, and delete contacts and calendar events.
- Browse SharePoint sites, document libraries, and folders.
- Resolve sharing URLs; list access; create links; grant named users access; and revoke permissions.
- Edit Excel workbooks stored in SharePoint/OneDrive in place through the Graph Workbook API.

The server runs entirely on your machine. Sign-in uses the Microsoft authorization-code flow with PKCE against your own Entra app registration; tokens are cached locally and encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. There is deliberately no tool that deletes a SharePoint or OneDrive file or folder.

microsoft_tenant_id.title: Microsoft Tenant ID
microsoft_tenant_id.description: Directory (tenant) ID of your Microsoft Entra app registration.

microsoft_client_id.title: Microsoft Client ID
microsoft_client_id.description: Application (client) ID of your Microsoft Entra app registration.

microsoft_client_secret.title: Microsoft Client Secret
microsoft_client_secret.description: Client secret Value (not the Secret ID) from Certificates & secrets. This server uses a confidential-client Web app registration, so a secret is required.

token_encryption_key.title: Token Encryption Key
token_encryption_key.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte key used to encrypt the local Microsoft token cache. Generate one with: python3 -c "import os, base64; print(base64.b64encode(os.urandom(32)).decode())"

known_mailboxes.title: Known Shared Mailboxes
known_mailboxes.description: Optional comma-separated shared or delegated mailbox addresses to hint to the model, such as support@company.com,billing@company.com.

helper_port.title: Local Sign-in Port
helper_port.description: Port for the local Microsoft sign-in helper page. Must match the redirect URI registered in Azure: http://localhost:PORT/auth/microsoft/callback

audit_log_enabled.title: Local Audit Log
audit_log_enabled.description: Write a local JSONL record of every tool call (metadata only: timestamp, tool, outcome, mailbox, key IDs). Never records tokens, secrets, message bodies, or attachment content.

mail_send_enabled.title: Enable Mail Sending
mail_send_enabled.description: Expose mail_send tools and request Mail.Send / Mail.Send.Shared. Off by default so Claude can draft mail but cannot transmit it.

pid_safe_mode.title: PID-safe Mode
pid_safe_mode.description: Fail closed on SharePoint/Excel unless allowlisted. Block listed investor locations and sensitivity labels, and redact SSN/tax ID patterns. Audit blocked requests without storing the content.

pid_mailbox_allowlist.title: PID Mailbox Allowlist
pid_mailbox_allowlist.description: Optional comma-separated mailbox addresses allowed in PID-safe mode. Empty blocks all mail, including the signed-in mailbox. Include every mailbox that should be reachable.

pid_mailbox_blocklist.title: PID Mailbox Blocklist
pid_mailbox_blocklist.description: Optional comma-separated mailbox addresses that PID-safe mode always blocks.

pid_site_allowlist.title: PID Site Allowlist
pid_site_allowlist.description: Optional comma-separated SharePoint site IDs or URL fragments allowed in PID-safe mode.

pid_drive_allowlist.title: PID Library Allowlist
pid_drive_allowlist.description: Optional comma-separated document library (drive) IDs or URL fragments allowed in PID-safe mode.

pid_folder_allowlist.title: PID Folder Allowlist
pid_folder_allowlist.description: Optional comma-separated folder path or URL fragments allowed in PID-safe mode.

pid_location_blocklist.title: PID Location Blocklist
pid_location_blocklist.description: Optional comma-separated path, URL, or ID fragments that PID-safe mode always blocks, such as investor PID libraries.

pid_blocked_sensitivity_labels.title: Blocked Sensitivity Labels
pid_blocked_sensitivity_labels.description: Optional comma-separated Microsoft sensitivity label IDs or display names to block when Graph returns them.

tools.name: m365_capabilities
tools.description: Read the model-facing guide for what this M365 MCP server can do and how to use its inbox, folder, attachment, thread, category, contact, and calendar tools.

tools.name: auth_status
tools.description: Check whether the server is connected to Microsoft 365 and see any known delegated mailbox hints.

tools.name: mail_list
tools.description: List messages from a mailbox folder. Use mailbox for shared/delegated mailboxes the signed-in Microsoft user can access.

tools.name: mail_check_inbox
tools.description: Quickly check an inbox or shared inbox folder. Defaults to unread messages in Inbox and includes triage metadata.

tools.name: mail_list_folders
tools.description: List top-level mail folders or direct child folders for own or shared mailboxes.

tools.name: mail_folder_tree
tools.description: Return a nested folder tree so the model can navigate subfolders by path or ID.

tools.name: mail_resolve_folder
tools.description: Resolve a folder path like Inbox/Clients/Acme or a child display name to a folder ID.

tools.name: mail_create_folder
tools.description: Create a top-level mail folder or a subfolder under parentFolderId/parentFolderPath.

tools.name: mail_rename_folder
tools.description: Rename a mail folder by folderId or folderPath.

tools.name: mail_delete_folder
tools.description: Delete a mail folder by folderId or folderPath.

tools.name: mail_list_rules
tools.description: List Outlook Inbox message rules for the mailbox.

tools.name: mail_create_rule
tools.description: Create an Outlook Inbox message rule. Use raw Graph conditions/actions or convenience fields such as senderContains and moveToFolderPath.

tools.name: mail_update_rule
tools.description: Update an Outlook Inbox message rule by ID.

tools.name: mail_delete_rule
tools.description: Delete an Outlook Inbox message rule by ID.

tools.name: mail_search
tools.description: Search a mailbox using Microsoft Graph $search. Use mailbox for shared/delegated mailboxes. Prefer mail_list filters for quick inbox triage because Graph search can be slower on large mailboxes.

tools.name: mail_get
tools.description: Get the full details and body of one message by ID. Use mailbox for shared/delegated mailboxes.

tools.name: mail_list_drafts
tools.description: List draft messages from the default Drafts folder. Use mailbox for shared/delegated mailboxes.

tools.name: mail_create_draft
tools.description: Create a new draft email. Use mailbox for shared/delegated mailboxes and optionally set from when you need a specific sender.

tools.name: mail_move
tools.description: Move a message to another folder. Pass a well-known folder name like Archive or DeletedItems, or set destinationFolderIsId when passing a raw folder ID.

tools.name: mail_list_attachments
tools.description: List attachment metadata for a message without downloading content.

tools.name: mail_get_attachment_content
tools.description: Read small text-like attachment content. Large or binary attachments return metadata with an unsupportedReason instead of content.

tools.name: mail_get_attachment_image
tools.description: View an image attachment. Returns the picture itself as image content so it can be read directly. Supports PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WEBP; other types return metadata with an unsupportedReason.

tools.name: mail_get_inline_images
tools.description: View the pictures embedded in a message body. Returns each inline image as image content, keyed by the contentId that the HTML body references as cid:. Set includeNonInline to also pull regular…

tools.name: mail_get_attachment_pdf_pages
tools.description: Look at the pages of a PDF attachment. Renders each page to an image so layout, tables, charts, signatures, stamps, and scanned documents can be read directly. Returns maxPages pages starting at…

tools.name: mail_get_thread
tools.description: Get messages in the same conversation by messageId or conversationId.

tools.name: mail_create_reply_draft
tools.description: Create a reply or reply-all draft in the original message thread. Sending is disabled; the user sends the draft from Outlook.

tools.name: mail_list_categories
tools.description: List Outlook master categories for a mailbox.

tools.name: mail_set_categories
tools.description: Replace the categories assigned to a message.

tools.name: mail_add_categories
tools.description: Add categories to a message without removing existing categories.

tools.name: mail_remove_categories
tools.description: Remove selected categories from a message.

tools.name: mail_clear_categories
tools.description: Remove all categories from a message.

tools.name: mail_create_category
tools.description: Create an Outlook master category definition.

tools.name: mail_update_category
tools.description: Update an Outlook master category color. Microsoft Graph does not support renaming existing master categories.

tools.name: mail_delete_category
tools.description: Delete an Outlook master category definition.

tools.name: mail_mark_read
tools.description: Mark a message read or unread.

tools.name: mail_set_flag
tools.description: Set a message follow-up flag status.

tools.name: contacts_list
tools.description: List Outlook contacts from the default or specified contact folder.

tools.name: contacts_search
tools.description: Search Outlook contacts by exact email or client-side name/email matching.

tools.name: contacts_get
tools.description: Get one Outlook contact by ID.

tools.name: contacts_create
tools.description: Create an Outlook contact with optional categories and addresses.

tools.name: contacts_update
tools.description: Update an Outlook contact by ID, including names, phones, email addresses, categories, and physical addresses.

tools.name: contacts_delete
tools.description: Delete an Outlook contact by ID.

tools.name: contacts_set_categories
tools.description: Replace all categories on an Outlook contact.

tools.name: contacts_add_categories
tools.description: Add categories to an Outlook contact without removing existing categories.

tools.name: contacts_remove_categories
tools.description: Remove selected categories from an Outlook contact.

tools.name: contacts_clear_categories
tools.description: Remove all categories from an Outlook contact.

tools.name: contacts_list_folders
tools.description: List Outlook contact folders or direct child contact folders.

tools.name: calendar_list_events
tools.description: List events in the default calendar over a time window. Use mailbox for shared/delegated calendars.

tools.name: calendar_create_event
tools.description: Create an event in the default calendar. Use mailbox for shared/delegated calendars.

tools.name: calendar_update_event
tools.description: Update an event in the default calendar by event ID.

tools.name: calendar_delete_event
tools.description: Delete an event from the default calendar by event ID.

tools.name: sharepoint_search_items
tools.description: Search across everything the signed-in user can access (all SharePoint sites and OneDrive) for files and folders by name or content. Best starting point for 'find this file/folder anywhere'.…

tools.name: sharepoint_search_sites
tools.description: Find SharePoint sites by keyword in their name or title.

tools.name: sharepoint_get_site
tools.description: Resolve a known SharePoint site by hostname and site path, for example hostname 'contoso.sharepoint.com' and sitePath 'Acquisitions'. Returns the site ID for listing its libraries.

tools.name: sharepoint_list_drives
tools.description: List a SharePoint site's document libraries. Each library is a drive; use its driveId to browse contents.

tools.name: sharepoint_list_children
tools.description: List the contents of a folder in a document library. Target the folder by itemId or by path relative to the drive root; omit both for the root. Optionally filter to file extensions or folders only.

tools.name: sharepoint_search_in_drive
tools.description: Search for files and folders by name within a single document library identified by driveId.

tools.name: sharepoint_get_item_by_url
tools.description: Resolve a SharePoint or OneDrive sharing/browser URL to a drive item, returning its driveId and itemId for further browsing.

tools.name: sharepoint_list_permissions
tools.description: List the sharing links, direct grants, roles, recipients, and inheritance state visible to the signed-in user for a file or folder. List permissions before revoking access.

tools.name: sharepoint_create_link
tools.description: Create or return a SharePoint/OneDrive view or edit link. Scope must be organization or anonymous; anonymous links may expose the item to anyone with the URL. Confirm the exact item, type, scope…

tools.name: sharepoint_grant_access
tools.description: Grant named recipients read or write access to a SharePoint or OneDrive file/folder. Invitations are not emailed unless sendInvitation=true. Confirm the item, recipients, role, message, and email…

tools.name: sharepoint_revoke_permission
tools.description: Revoke a non-inherited direct permission or an entire sharing link by permissionId. List permissions first and confirm the exact item and permission with the user before setting confirm=true.

tools.name: workbook_resolve
tools.description: Resolve an Excel workbook to a driveId + itemId pair for the other workbook tools. Provide a shareUrl, or driveId + itemId, or driveId + itemPath (path relative to the drive root). The returned…

tools.name: workbook_list_worksheets
tools.description: List the worksheets (tabs) in an Excel workbook.

tools.name: workbook_list_tables
tools.description: List Excel tables in a workbook, or in a single worksheet when worksheet is given.

tools.name: workbook_get_range
tools.description: Read a fixed range like 'A1:O5' from a worksheet. Returns raw values, display text, cell formulas, number formats, and the resolved address.

tools.name: workbook_get_used_range
tools.description: Read the used (non-empty) range of a worksheet. Use this to discover the data extent before reading or writing specific cells.

tools.name: workbook_update_range
tools.description: Write values, formulas, and/or number formats into a fixed range in place. The shape of values/formulas/numberFormat must match the address dimensions. formulas cells may be literal values or…

tools.name: workbook_add_table_row
tools.description: Append one or more rows to an Excel table. values is a 2D array; each inner list is one row and must match the table's column count and order. index=None appends at the end; index=0 inserts at top.

tools.name: workbook_create_session
tools.description: Create a workbook session and return its sessionId. Pass that sessionId to subsequent workbook calls to batch them consistently. persistChanges=True writes to the stored file; False is a…

tools.name: workbook_close_session
tools.description: Close a workbook session previously opened with workbook_create_session.

tools.name: workbook_get_ranges
tools.description: Batch-read many ranges in one call. ranges is a list of {worksheet, address} objects. Each result carries values, text, formulas, numberFormat, and the resolved address, in input order. A failed…

tools.name: workbook_update_ranges
tools.description: Batch-write many ranges in one call. updates is a list of objects, each with worksheet and address plus any of formulas, values, numberFormat. formulas cells may be literal values or formula strings…

tools.name: workbook_calculate
tools.description: Force a recalculation of the workbook so computed cells are current before reading them back. calculationType is one of Recalculate, Full (default), or FullRebuild. Pass a sessionId to recalc inside…

tools.name: workbook_list_names
tools.description: List defined names. Workbook-scoped names when worksheet is omitted; worksheet-scoped names when worksheet is given. Each name includes its 'refers to' value/formula and scope.

tools.name: workbook_get_name_range
tools.description: Resolve a defined name to its range and read it. Returns the resolved address plus values, text, formulas, and numberFormat. Provide worksheet for a worksheet-scoped name; omit it for a…

tools.name: workbook_clear_range
tools.description: Clear a range in place. applyTo is Contents (values/formulas only, default), Formats, or All. This edits the stored file via Excel's engine; it never deletes the workbook file.

tools.name: workbook_copy_range
tools.description: Copy into address (the destination range) from sourceRange (e.g. 'Unit Mix'!A1:B5 for a cross-sheet source). copyType is one of All (default), Formulas, Values, or Formats.

tools.name: workbook_insert_range
tools.description: Insert blank cells at address, shifting existing cells. shift is Down (default) or Right. Useful for insert-at-top patterns.

tools.name: workbook_delete_range
tools.description: Delete the cells at address and shift remaining cells to fill the gap. shift is Up (default) or Left. To delete a whole row, pass a full-row address (e.g. 5:5 or A5:Z5) with shift=Up. This removes…

tools.name: workbook_create_table
tools.description: Create an Excel table over an existing range (convert a range to a table). address is a range on the worksheet like A1:D20; hasHeaders=True (default) treats the first row as column headers. Returns…

tools.name: workbook_sort_table
tools.description: Sort an Excel table by one or more columns. fields is a list of sort conditions, each {key: <zero-based column index in the table>, ascending: true|false} (an optional sortOn may be Value…

tools.name: workbook_filter_table
tools.description: Apply a filter to one column of an Excel table. column is the column's header name. criteria is a Graph filter-criteria object, e.g. {filterOn: 'values', values: ['A','B']} to keep matching rows, or…

tools.name: workbook_clear_table_filters
tools.description: Clear all column filters on an Excel table, restoring every row to view.

tools.name: workbook_format_range
tools.description: Apply visual formatting to a range in place: fill color, font (bold/italic/underline/color/size/name), alignment (horizontal/vertical/wrapText), and borders. Colors are hex strings like #FFFF00.…

tools.name: workbook_set_column_width
tools.description: Set the width of one or more columns, addressed like A:A or A:C. Pass width (in points) for a fixed width, or autofit=True to size columns to their content.

tools.name: workbook_set_row_height
tools.description: Set the height of one or more rows, addressed like 1:1 or 1:10. Pass height (in points) for a fixed height, or autofit=True to size rows to their content.
